title: PI(4,5)P <sub>2</sub> -dependence of GABA <sub>A</sub> receptor channel function revealed by optogenetic manipulation of a binding site
authors: Risa Mori-Kreiner; Rizki Tsari Andriani; Tobias Strasdeit; Junxian Zhou; Naoyuki Miyashita; Yasushige Yonezawa; Takafumi Kawai; Nikolaj Klöcker; Yasushi Okamura
one_liner_zh: 该文研究GABA_A受体与PI(4,5)P2脂质结合的功能，虽用MD模拟但对象为蛋白-脂质互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: /SUMMARY Ionotropic GABA A receptors (GABA A Rs) mediate fast inhibitory neurotransmission in mammalian brains. While recent structural studies have identified that phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate [PI(4,5)P 2 ], a well-established regulator of numerous ion channels, binds to the α1 subunits of GABA A Rs, the functional relevance of this binding has remained elusive. Here, we combine electrophysiology, molecular dynamics simulations, and a recently developed caged lysine technology to define the role of PI(4,5)P 2 in GABA A Rs. We show that GABA A Rs are insensitive to acute PI(4,5)P 2 depletions by voltage-sensing phosphatase, but sensitivity is conferred by neutralizing the K311 binding site, indicating high-affinity binding. Caging of K311 by use of genetic code expansion recapitulated phenotypes of K311 mutant, conferring sensitivity to PI(4,5)P 2 depletion, whereas uncaging restored insensitivity. Furthermore, caging K311 revealed decelerated activation, which then can be accelerated by uncaging. Additionally, PI(4,5)P 2 -dependence extends to glycine receptors, suggesting PI(4,5)P 2 is an important endogenous phospholipid modulator of inhibitory receptor channels.
abstract_zh: /SUMMARY 离子型GABA A受体（GABA A Rs）在哺乳动物大脑中介导快速抑制性神经传递。尽管近期结构研究已确定磷脂酰肌醇4,5-二磷酸[PI(4,5)P 2 ]，一种多种离子通道的公认调节因子，与GABA A Rs的α1亚基结合，但该结合的功能相关性仍不明确。在此，我们结合电生理学、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟以及一种新开发的光笼赖氨酸技术，来定义PI(4,5)P 2 在GABA A Rs中的作用。我们显示，GABA A Rs对电压感应磷酸酶引起的急性PI(4,5)P 2 耗竭不敏感，但通过中和K311结合位点可获得敏感性，表明存在高亲和力结合。利用遗传密码扩展对K311进行光笼化，重现了K311突变体的表型，赋予对PI(4,5)P 2 耗竭的敏感性，而解笼则恢复不敏感性。此外，光笼化K311揭示了解笼可加速的激活减速。另外，PI(4,5)P 2 依赖性延伸至甘氨酸受体，表明PI(4,5)P 2 是抑制性受体通道的重要内源性磷脂调节因子。
